messages:
Aisha Khan: Flagging an incident - customer HelixCare (HC-721) reported ~35% of activations failed during their nightly import (01:42 UTC). Renewal touchpoint in ~5 weeks. Need a short customer status, an exec-friendly 2-line blurb, and office hours.
Tom Rivera: paste the top error lines pls
Aisha Khan: support snippet: `ingest-coordinator: manifest checksum mismatch for manifest_id=mh_77b2` then a stream of retries -> `upstream 502` and `shard warm timeout`. uploaded logs to ticket.
Kai Nakamura: interesting  looks like a manifest staging/consistency issue led to partial writes that exposed a cache-warm race. mitigation suggestion: 1) disable continuous batching for HC-721, 2) switch the tenant ingest path to manifest-validated replay (idempotent), 3) warm shard cache and run replay in gated tranches with shadow-write verification. Steps 1+2 in ~30m, replay in gated tranches ~2.5h.
InfraBot: Incident created: INC-HC-721-2026 severity=P2. Assigned: eng-runtime, cs-response.
Sophie Laurent: please draft a concise customer note (<6 lines) with ETA and 2 office hours options + an ask for priority seat IDs. Keep language non-technical.
Tom Rivera: also add a short safety blurb: `replays are idempotent; we will run shadow-writes and validation checks to prevent duplicates`
Sophie Laurent: Draft -> `Hi HelixCare team, we9re aware a portion of your activation import did not complete successfully this morning. What happened: a manifest validation mismatch caused retries and partial failures during a high-volume import. What we9re doing: disabling tenant continuous batching (ETA ~30m), switching to a manifest-validated idempotent replay and warming your shard (ETA ~3h), and running validation checks before final writes. We9re offering dedicated office hours for hands-on support and will apply a temporary account credit. Please reply with priority seat IDs and preferred office hours.`
CSM - Arjun: sent to HelixCare (ticket #100122). Customer replied: "Thanks  Please prioritize seats 17,18,19. Prefer Mon 11:00 PT office hours."
Aisha Khan: action items: @Tom disable batching + enable manifest-validated replay toggles (ETA 30m). @Kai reserve CPU for gated replay and enable shadow-write validation. @Arjun send office hours invite and surface per-tenant progress widget in the console. Finance to prep interim credit. Also draft exec 2-line note for their buyer.
Tom Rivera: Change applied: continuous batching disabled for tenant HC-721 at 1753211400. Enabled manifest-validated replay mode.
Kai Nakamura: warming shard cache now; starting gated replay window shortly. Replay configured to process small tranches and run shadow-write verification; rate-limited to avoid any duplicate ingestion. Estimated complete ~2.5h from now.
Sophie Laurent: exec blurb candidate -> "HelixCare experienced a partial activation interruption due to a manifest validation mismatch during a large import. Immediate mitigations are in place; manifest-validated replays and validation checks are running; we9re providing a temporary credit and will deliver a post-incident RCA within 48 hours."
Aisha Khan: note: we9re using 48h for RCA here due to customer SLA; confirm if that9s ok @Tom
Tom Rivera: 48h is fine as long as eng runtime has the draft. we9ll commit to customer-friendly summary in 8h and full technical RCA in 48h.
CSM - Arjun: office hours invite sent for Mon 11:00 PT. Customer acknowledged.
Tom Rivera: first replay tranche raised activations from ~62% -> ~88%. monitoring hooks show no duplicate writes thanks to shadow verification. will post +60m update.
Kai Nakamura: reserving follow-ups: RCA draft due 48h, customer-friendly summary in 8h, credits applied within 24h. schedule a feedback pulse 7 days after closure: `https://forms.redwood-inference.com/incident-feedback?tenant=HC-721`.
Aisha Khan: keeping this thread as the single source for all external updates. please react when read. :white_check_mark:
Tom Rivera: :white_check_mark:
Kai Nakamura: :thumbsup:
CSM - Arjun: :handshake:
Sophie Laurent: :sparkles:
